SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF WESTBROOK
COUNTY OF MARION

THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF WESTBROOK,
                Plaintiff,
        v.                                  Case No. CR-2024-00871
DANIEL R. ORTEGA,
                Defendant.

INDICTMENT

The Grand Jury of Marion County, by this Indictment, accuses DANIEL R. ORTEGA of the following:

COUNT ONE — ROBBERY IN THE SECOND DEGREE (Westbrook Penal Code § 160.10):
On or about March 14, 2024, at approximately 11:42 p.m., at 4421 Linden Avenue, Marion County, Westbrook, the defendant did forcibly steal property, to wit, one Apple iPhone 15 and approximately $312 in United States currency, from the person of ALICIA M. KEMP, by means of physical force.

COUNT TWO — CRIMINAL POSSESSION OF A WEAPON IN THE FOURTH DEGREE (Westbrook Penal Code § 265.01):
On or about the same date and place, the defendant did knowingly possess a folding knife with a blade exceeding four inches.

COUNT THREE — RESISTING ARREST (Westbrook Penal Code § 205.30):
On or about March 15, 2024, at approximately 12:08 a.m., at 4500 Linden Avenue, the defendant did intentionally prevent or attempt to prevent a police officer, to wit, Officer M. Halberg #4471, from effecting an authorized arrest.

Filed: April 2, 2024
                                        /s/ R. Choi
                                        Assistant District Attorney
                                        Marion County
